title: vdog original recording v1 frame index record
description: One complete compact JSONL line of /vdog/v1/clips/<clip_id>/frames.jsonl (docs/specs/media-format.md section 3). Bounds come from the section 2 table. Cross-record rules (seq continuity, offset continuity, strictly increasing t_us, first t_us == 0, CRC over the exact payload bytes) are clip-level invariants enforced by tools/contracts and reported with stable codes; they are not expressible per line.

v.description: Media contract version; unsupported major versions are rejected.

seq.description: Consecutive from zero; at most 3,600 frames per clip.

offset.description: Byte offset of the JPEG SOI. Bounded here by the shared JSON integer range; the payload bound (at most 268,435,456 bytes) and continuity are clip-level invariants.

size.description: JPEG payload length including SOI and EOI.

t_us.description: Capture time in microseconds relative to the first retained frame of this segment; first record is zero and later values strictly increase. Bounded by the 120,000,000 us hard segment maximum.

crc32.description: CRC-32/ISO-HDLC of the exact JPEG payload bytes, eight lowercase hexadecimal characters.
